---
title: "PROC SQL"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r setup}
library(sasonr)
```

PROC SQL is parsed by sasonr's own SQL parser. Joins and grouping run on
DuckDB; SAS semantics are applied in R: missing values sort and compare as
the smallest value, character comparisons ignore trailing blanks, summary
statistics are merged back to detail rows ("remerging") with the SAS NOTE,
`CALCULATED` columns and `INTO :macro-variable` work as in SAS.

## Summaries, CALCULATED and CASE

```{r}
res <- sas_run("
data a;
  input g $ v;
  datalines;
A 1
B 2
A 3
;
run;
proc sql noprint;
  select distinct g into :glist separated by ',' from a;
  create table s as
    select g, sum(v) as tot, calculated tot * 2 as dbl,
           case when calculated tot > 3 then 'H' else 'L' end as cls
    from a group by g;
quit;
%put glist=&glist;
")
res$log
res$work$s
```

## Remerging summary statistics

```{r}
res <- sas_run("
data a;
  input id $ grp $ x;
  datalines;
1 A 10
2 A 30
3 B 5
;
run;
proc sql;
  create table pct as
    select id, grp, x, x / sum(x) * 100 as pct
    from a group by grp;
quit;
")
grep("remerging", res$log, value = TRUE)
res$work$pct
```
